correctness.rationale: For any sequence the length-five edge set is Eulerian, reversal-pair-exclusive and nonpalindromic. Each of six nonconstant palindromic vertices has indegree ≤1. An explicit integer potential certificate checks 216 nonpalindromic edge inequalities; by balance and nonnegative 108 reversal-pair weights summing to 486 it forces 6m≤486+72=558. A packaged 93-symbol cyclic witness meets every orientability condition. The exact, reproducible standard-library checker needs no approximation.
